item.title: Gases de efeito estufa atingem recorde; agência meteorológica da ONU prevê novo aumento com El Niño
item.description: Os níveis de gases de efeito estufa na atmosfera atingiram níveis sem precedentes em 2025, o que pode causar um aquecimento ainda maior do planeta e levar a eventos climáticos mais extremos, afirmou a Organização Meteorológica Mundial (OMM), da ONU, em um relatório divulgado nesta terça-feira.
item.dc:creator: Olivia Le Poidevin
item.content:encoded: Os níveis de gases de efeito estufa na atmosfera atingiram níveis sem precedentes em 2025, o que pode causar um aquecimento ainda maior do planeta e levar a eventos climáticos mais extremos, afirmou a Organização Meteorológica Mundial (OMM), da ONU, em um relatório divulgado nesta terça-feira. A concentração média global de CO₂ na atmosfera atingiu 426,8 partes por milhão em 2025, cerca de 153% do nível pré-industrial de 1750, segundo o relatório. O nível subiu 2,8 ppm em relação ao ano anterior, um aumento anual maior do que a média da última década. As concentrações de outros gases de efeito estufa importantes — metano e óxido nitroso — atingiram níveis recordes em 2025, situando-se em 267% e 126% dos níveis pré-industriais, respectivamente. O relatório mede a quantidade de gás que se acumula na atmosfera, e não as novas emissões anuais. A OMM compartilhará as conclusões com os negociadores na conferência climática da ONU COP31, em Antália, na Turquia, em novembro, e alertou que um forte El Niño poderia elevar ainda mais as concentrações este ano. “Cada parte por milhão adicional é importante porque retém calor extra. Na prática, estamos sobrecarregando o oceano e a atmosfera”, disse a secretária-geral adjunta da OMM, Ko Barrett. “Isso significa que ondas de calor, ciclones tropicais e tempestades estão se intensificando mais rapidamente do que nossas referências históricas nos prepararam para enfrentar.” Este ano, regiões do mundo, incluindo a Europa, registraram temperaturas escaldantes no verão, além de inundações devastadoras na Ásia e em outros lugares. A OMM afirmou que prevê que as concentrações de CO₂ aumentem ainda mais este ano devido à queima de combustíveis fósseis e ao início de um forte El Niño, o que causará um clima mais seco e tornará mais difícil para os sumidouros de carbono absorverem as emissões. A OMM também manifestou preocupação com o hexafluoreto de enxofre, ou SF₆, um gás de efeito estufa amplamente utilizado em equipamentos elétricos, afirmando que seu aumento em 2025 atingiu um recorde histórico. O potencial de aquecimento global do SF₆ é mais de 24.000 vezes maior do que o do CO₂ e ele pode permanecer na atmosfera por mais de 1.000 anos.

item.title: USA-La confiance des consommateurs progresse plus que prévu en octobre - Conference Board
item.description: La confiance des consommateurs aux États-Unis s'est améliorée plus que prévu en octobre, selon l'enquête mensuelle du Conference Board publiée mardi.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La confiance des consommateurs aux États-Unis s'est améliorée plus que prévu en octobre, selon l'enquête mensuelle du Conference Board publiée mardi. L'indice de confiance calculé par l'organisation patronale s'établit ce mois-ci à 91,7 contre 84,2 (révisé de 81,9) en septembre. Le consensus des économistes interrogés par Reuters prévoyait un indice à 81.

item.title: Purdue, Matt Painter agree on extension through 2030-31
item.description: Purdue men's basketball coach Matt Painter signed a contract extension through the 2030-31 season on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Purdue men's basketball coach Matt Painter signed a contract extension through the 2030-31 season on Tuesday. The deal announced by the school includes increased annual compensation plus retention and performance bonuses. Painter, 56, owns a 501-224 record entering his 22nd season with the Boilermakers. The Purdue alumnus has guided the program to 17 NCAA Tournament appearances -- including the last 11. He led the Boilermakers to the Final Four in 2024 and the Elite Eight last season. "Purdue is a very special place for me, and it's an honor to continue to be the head basketball coach at my alma mater," Painter said. "I'm humbled that the Purdue administration continues to put their faith in me to lead this program, and am excited to continue to elevate our program with class and strive to reach all of our goals on and off the court." Painter is the second-winningest head coach at Purdue behind Gene Keady (512-270). "Under Matt Painter's leadership, Purdue men's basketball has established itself as one of the nation's premier programs through its success on the court and commitment to excellence in all areas," athletic director Tommy McClelland said. "The culture Matt has built, grounded in a shared pursuit of excellence, is reflected in the program's 106-game sellout streak at Mackey Arena and the tremendous support Boilermaker fans and donors provide at away and neutral-site games across the country. We are proud to have Matt leading our program now and into the future. We remain committed to supporting his efforts to sustain our incredible success on the court, in the classroom and throughout the community." Purdue tips off the season against No. 15 Gonzaga on Monday in Las Vegas. --Field Level Media

item.title: Report: Packers C Sean Rhyan (ankle) out at least a month
item.description: Packers center Sean Rhyan likely will be sidelined at least a month with a high-ankle sprain, CBS Sports reported Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Packers center Sean Rhyan likely will be sidelined at least a month with a high-ankle sprain, CBS Sports reported Tuesday. Rhyan, 26, sustained the injury during the first quarter of Sunday's 20-17 loss at Detroit and did not return to the game. Rhyan has started every game at center this season for Green Bay and has not missed a game since the 2023 season. According to the report, the 2022 third-round pick is not expected to undergo tightrope surgery. Jacob Monk replaced Rhyan against the Lions but lasted only five offensive snaps before leaving with a thigh injury. Second-year pro John Williams, the Packers' backup left tackle, filled in at center and played 63 snaps (five on special teams). The Packers placed Monk on injured reserve on Monday and called up lineman Mekhi Becton Sr. from the practice squad. Green Bay (4-3) has a short turnaround before hosting the Carolina Panthers (3-3) on Thursday night. --Field Level Media

item.title: BOURSE Wall Street ouvre en hausse à la veille de la décision de la Fed
item.description: La Bourse de New York a ouvert en hausse mardi, rassurée par les premières publications de résultats d'entreprises à la veille des annonces de politique monétaire de la Réserve fédérale.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Bourse de New York a ouvert en hausse mardi, rassurée par les premières publications de résultats d'entreprises à la veille des annonces de politique monétaire de la Réserve fédérale. Dans les premiers échanges, l'indice Dow Jones (.DJI) gagne 22,84 points, soit 0,04%, à 52.384,42 points et le Standard & Poor's 500 (.SPX) , plus large, progresse de 0,31% à 7.700,42 points. Le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) prend 0,50%, soit 130,45 points, à 26.299,83 points. La Réserve fédérale américaine (Fed) devrait, selon toute vraisemblance, annoncer mercredi le [USN:L6N46C0GT TEXT:"maintien"] de ses taux après la hausse du mois dernier. Les marchés anticipent toutefois au moins deux nouvelles hausses d'ici mi-2027, les principaux indicateurs d'inflation restant élevés en raison du conflit persistant entre les États-Unis et l'Iran. En attendant, les marchés actions réagissent à la pluie de résultats d'entreprises du jour, marquée par une vague de révisions à la hausse des objectifs financiers, notamment pour Hilton (HLT.N) (-3,4%), UPS (UPS.N) (+1,75%) et Coca-Cola (KO.N) (-0,3%). Les géants de l'informatique Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , Microsoft (MSFT.O) et Amazon (AMZN.O) doivent publier leurs résultats cette semaine. Les investisseurs seront particulièrement attentifs au rapport entre les investissements massifs dans l'intelligence artificielle et les perspectives de croissance. Aux valeurs individuelles, le groupe hôtelier Hilton perd 3,4% après un chiffre d'affaires inférieur aux attentes au troisième trimestre en dépit d'un relèvement de ses objectifs. L'avionneur américain Boeing (BA.N) recule de 1,4% après avoir [USN:L6N46D0SS TEXT:"fait état"] d'une perte plus importante que prévu au troisième trimestre. Paypal (PYPL.O) avance de 1,7% après avoir revu à la hausse sa prévision de bénéfice. * Pour les valeurs à suivre, cliquez sur [USN:L5N46D0VN]

item.title: Komatsu header seals another Asian Champions League win for Kobe
item.description: Vissel Kobe secured a late 1-0 win over South Korea's Daejeon Citizen to continue their perfect start to the eastern phase of the Asian Champions League Elite on Tuesday as Vietnam's Cong An Ha Noi picked up their first win in the competition.
item.dc:creator: Michael Church
item.content:encoded: Vissel Kobe secured a late 1-0 win over South Korea's Daejeon Citizen to continue their perfect start to the eastern phase of the Asian Champions League Elite on Tuesday as Vietnam's Cong An Ha Noi picked up their first win in the competition. Ren Komatsu's glancing header seven minutes from time moved Kobe on to nine points from three matches as eight teams chase berths in the knockout rounds. "We were playing away from home so, above all, it was important to keep our mindset focused on moving forward," said Komatsu. "In both attack and defence, I think the key was to always be proactive and play on the front foot." Kobe sit two points clear of Johor Darul Ta'zim after the Malaysian side registered a 3-0 home win over Port FC from Thailand through second-half goals from Jonathan Silva, Bergson and Stoichkov. Cong An Ha Noi handed Chinese hosts Shanghai Port a surprise 3-2 loss to claim their first victory in their debut appearance in the competition. Brayan Perea scored twice for Mano Polking's side, including the 69th-minute winner and Shanghai Port's Mateus squandered the opportunity to equalise when he hit the post from the penalty spot. "Cong An Ha Noi today made history," Perea said. "The team played very well against a good team that has good players." Kyoto Sanga fought back from two goals down to crush visitors Newcastle Jets from Australia 5-2. Patrick Wood struck twice from the penalty spot for Newcastle but Kyoto rallied in the second half with Alex Souza scoring twice. Lee young-jae netted in the 64th minute to earn Jeonbuk Motors a 2-2 draw with hosts Beijing Guoan while Thailand's Ratchaburi FC held visitors Kashiwa Reysol to a 0-0 draw. Unbeaten Japanese duo Kashima Antlers and Gamba Osaka play Pohang Steelers and Buriram United on Wednesday. The first eight finishers in the league phase in both east and west Asia advance to March's last 16 phase with the quarter-finals, semi-finals and final to be played in Saudi Arabia in April and May.

item.title: S&P 500 e Nasdaq sobem em dia de queda do preço do petróleo
item.description: O S&P 500 e o Nasdaq subiam nesta terça-feira, à medida que a queda nos preços do petróleo impulsionava o apetite pelo risco antes da decisão de política monetária do Federal Reserve, nesta semana, enquanto os investidores também avaliavam uma série de resultados financeiros importantes das empresas.
item.dc:creator: Shashwat Chauhan, Utkarsh Hathi
item.content:encoded: O S&P 500 e o Nasdaq subiam nesta terça-feira, à medida que a queda nos preços do petróleo impulsionava o apetite pelo risco antes da decisão de política monetária do Federal Reserve, nesta semana, enquanto os investidores também avaliavam uma série de resultados financeiros importantes das empresas. Às 12h12 (horário de Brasília), o Índice Dow Jones (.DJI) mostrava estabilidade, aos 52.360,95 pontos. O S&P 500 (.SPX) subia 0,49%, para 7.714,75 pontos, enquanto o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) tinha alta de 0,87%, para 26.397,69 pontos. Espera-se que o Fed mantenha as taxas de juros inalteradas na quarta-feira, após um aumento no mês passado, embora os mercados estejam precificando pelo menos mais dois aumentos até meados de 2027, já que os principais indicadores de inflação permanecem elevados nos EUA na esteira do conflito no Oriente Médio. O petróleo Brent recuava pela segunda sessão consecutiva em um pregão volátil, embora ainda se mantivesse próximo de seu nível mais alto desde o final de abril. A queda de mais de 2% nas ações da fabricante de tintas Sherwin-Williams (SHW.N) , após resultados trimestrais abaixo do esperado, pesava sobre o Dow Jones. Já as ações de megacapitalização e de crescimento apresentavam desempenho misto. As ações da Tesla (TSLA.O) subiam quase 3%, consolidando o ganho de mais de 5% registrado na sessão anterior. As ações de fabricantes de chips (.SOX) subiam pelo terceiro dia consecutivo após algumas semanas difíceis, enquanto as empresas de nuvem CoreWeave (CRWV.O) e Nebius (NBIS.O) também estavam sendo negociadas com fortes altas. A Meta (META.O) caía depois que a empresa aumentou sua maior captação de recursos de capital da história para US$97,5 bilhões, a fim de financiar a expansão da IA. A iniciativa também atraiu interesse de até US$5 bilhões no total por parte da Nvidia (NVDA.O) , da Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.O) e da Broadcom (AVGO.O) . O plano surge em um momento em que as crescentes preocupações com a viabilidade dos gastos financiados por dívida, diante do aumento dos custos de empréstimos, têm pesado sobre as negociações relacionadas à IA. Nesse contexto, os investidores agora estarão atentos aos resultados financeiros das gigantes da tecnologia Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , Microsoft (MSFT.O) e Amazon.com (AMZN.O) no final desta semana, em busca de indícios de que os pesados investimentos em IA estão se traduzindo em crescimento.

item.title: Kyiv plans to build water crossings as Russia escalates bridge strikes
item.description: Ukraine's Kyiv plans to allocate 1 billion hryvnias ($22 million) to build water crossings over the River Dnipro that divides the capital into two parts, the city mayor said on Tuesday, as Russia escalates its attacks on bridges.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ukraine's Kyiv plans to allocate 1 billion hryvnias ($22 million) to build water crossings over the River Dnipro that divides the capital into two parts, the city mayor said on Tuesday, as Russia escalates its attacks on bridges. Russia has significantly stepped up its strikes on logistics in and around Kyiv in recent months, and in October it struck bridges, disrupting transportation for hundreds of thousands of people. Mayor Vitali Klitschko said on Telegram that the city's defence council discussed "the project to build combined water crossings over the River Dnipro and the access roads leading to them." Klitschko did not give further details. Water crossings come in various forms, including pontoons, fords and other low-lying structures that enable people and vehicles to cross. Disruptions to bridge traffic could become a critical issue for Kyiv residents who live and work on opposite sides of the wide river and have to commute across daily. Kyiv has six main bridges. On Tuesday, an overnight Russian [USN:L2N46D011 TEXT:"missile strike"] hit the South Bridge, President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said, calling it a "serious escalation". Earlier, Russia targeted other bridges in the city with drones. ($1 = 45.5605 hryvnias)

item.title: Monedas operan mixtas, real brasileño lidera ganancias tras desplome previo
item.description: Las monedas de América Latina anotaban un desempeño dispar el martes, en una jornada en que el real brasileño lideraba las alzas tras el desplome de la ronda previa, mientras la atención del mercado se centraba en el inicio de la reunión de política monetaria de la Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos.
item.dc:creator: Froilan Romero
item.content:encoded: Las monedas de América Latina anotaban un desempeño dispar el martes, en una jornada en que el real brasileño lideraba las alzas tras el desplome de la ronda previa, mientras la atención del mercado se centraba en el inicio de la reunión de política monetaria de la Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos. * Los activos brasileños se hundieron el lunes debido al triunfo del presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula Da Silva en el balotaje ante Flávio Bolsonaro, favorito de los mercados. * La Fed mantendría sin cambios las tasas de interés el miércoles, y el mercado espera pistas sobre si podría haber un alza en diciembre. Según la herramienta FedWatch de CME, los operadores ven una probabilidad del 80% de un aumento de tipos a fines de año. * El real brasileño se apreciaba un 1,03%, a 5,3537 unidades por dólar, tras caer a primera hora del lunes poco más de un 12%. En tanto, el índice Bovespa (.BVSP) de la bolsa B3 de Sao Paulo bajaba un 0,26%, a 176.148,66 puntos, luego que en la víspera anotó su mayor caída diaria desde marzo de 2020. * El peso mexicano cotizaba 18,6307 unidades por dólar, con una caída del 0,36%. El principal índice accionario S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , que integran las 35 empresas más líquidas del mercado mexicano, subía un 0,15%, a 69.575,95 unidades, después de tres sesiones de pérdidas. * Los inversionistas mantenían la mirada puesta en la temporada de resultados corporativos del tercer trimestre, que concluye esta semana. * En Argentina, el peso mayorista se apreciaba un 0,1% a 1.539,5 por dólar , aunque en su apertura anotó el piso récord de 1.550 unidades, ante un banco central (BCRA) que el lunes cortó una racha de 19 días consecutivos con compras de divisas para reforzar sus reservas internacionales. * En tanto, el índice bursátil MSCI Merval (.MMXMRVLGA) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires ganaba 0,7% tras una caída del 2,9% el lunes, y los bonos públicos extrabursátiles promediaban un ligero avance del 0,2%, luego de ceder el 0,6% el lunes. * El peso chileno , se apreciaba un 0,68%, a 986,10/986,40 por dólar, apoyado en un alza en los precios del cobre, el mayor envío del país. En tanto, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , escalaba un 0,98%, a 10.679,73 unidades. * El peso colombiano se depreciaba un 0,64% a 3.150 unidades por dólar, luego de tres jornadas de ganancias; al tiempo que el índice accionario de la bolsa, el MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) perdía un 0,15% a 2.501,47 puntos. * La moneda peruana, el sol , se depreciaba un 0,15% a 3,4470/3,4480 unidades por dólar. Por su parte, la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) caía apenas un 0,05% a 1.511 puntos.

item.title: Germany's TK Elevator posts record annual profit ahead of combination with Kone
item.description: TK Elevator reported record fourth-quarter and full-year 2026 results on Tuesday, marking a fourth straight year of double-digit profit growth as expansion in its higher-margin service and modernisation businesses boosted earnings.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: TK Elevator reported record fourth-quarter and full-year 2026 results on Tuesday, marking a fourth straight year of double-digit profit growth as expansion in its higher-margin service and modernisation businesses boosted earnings. The privately held German elevator maker is in the process of combining with Finnish rival Kone, with the deal expected to close in the second quarter of 2027 at the earliest. FY adjusted EBITDA rose 10% to €1.72 billion ($1.92 billion), while margin improved 100 bps to 18.5% Q4 adjusted EBITDA was €504 million FY 2026 sales increased 4% to €9.3 billion, with service and modernization accounting for 67% of revenue TKE said regulatory reviews of the planned Kone combination were progressing as expected, with the companies continuing to target about €700 million in annual synergies after completion ($1 = 0.8961 euros)

item.title: Artiva suspenderá terapia celular tras muerte de dos pacientes y reducirá plantilla en 94%
item.description: Artiva Biotherapeutics anunció el martes que suspendería el desarrollo de una terapia celular experimental para determinadas enfermedades autoinmunes —su principal candidato— tras la muerte de dos pacientes, lo que provocó una caída del 32% en el valor de sus acciones.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Artiva Biotherapeutics (ARTV.O) anunció el martes que suspendería el desarrollo de una terapia celular experimental para determinadas enfermedades autoinmunes —su principal candidato— tras la muerte de dos pacientes, lo que provocó una caída del 32% en el valor de sus acciones. La empresa recortará su plantilla en aproximadamente un 94% y evaluará alternativas estratégicas, según ha informado. A continuación, más detalles: La terapia AlloNK de Artiva se estaba probando como posible tratamiento para enfermedades autoinmunes, como la artritis reumatoide, en un ensayo en fase intermedia. La empresa indicó que uno de los pacientes del ensayo sufrió un episodio neurológico mortal tras el tratamiento. El investigador y un comité independiente de revisión de seguridad consideraron que el episodio probablemente estaba relacionado con complicaciones causadas por el fármaco quimioterapéutico fludarabina, según la empresa. Un segundo paciente del ensayo sufrió una muerte súbita unos dos meses después de iniciar el tratamiento, lo que un investigador valoró como ajeno a AlloNK, añadió Artiva. "Las dos muertes de pacientes, sumadas a la disminución de la durabilidad, transformaron rápidamente lo que parecía un camino prometedor y diferenciado en uno que conllevaba demasiado riesgo e incertidumbre", afirmó Josh Schimmer, analista de Cantor Fitzgerald. Schimmer señaló que seguir adelante con AlloNK habría supuesto un camino lleno de dificultades y con un costo de capital increíblemente elevado. A 30 de septiembre, Artiva contaba con unos 319,1 millones de dólares en efectivo, equivalentes de efectivo e inversiones. A 31 de diciembre de 2025, la empresa contaba con 104 empleados a tiempo completo, según su reporte anual.

item.title: João Pedro desfalcará Chelsea por “algumas semanas”, diz Xabi Alonso
item.description: O atacante João Pedro, do Chelsea, deve ficar afastado dos gramados por algumas semanas após sofrer uma lesão na coxa durante um treino, informou o técnico Xabi Alonso nesta terça-feira, antes do confronto da equipe contra o Liverpool pela Copa da Liga.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O atacante João Pedro, do Chelsea, deve ficar afastado dos gramados por algumas semanas após sofrer uma lesão na coxa durante um treino, informou o técnico Xabi Alonso nesta terça-feira, antes do confronto da equipe contra o Liverpool pela Copa da Liga. O brasileiro de 25 anos ficou de fora da derrota de sábado para o Tottenham Hotspur após se lesionar durante um treino na sexta-feira. “Ele sofreu uma lesão na coxa e ficará fora por algumas semanas”, disse Alonso aos repórteres. “Vamos ver quantas; não queremos fazer previsões, mas ele não estará pronto para os próximos jogos.” João Pedro teve um início de temporada brilhante, marcando cinco gols e dando três assistências em sete partidas em todas as competições. Alonso reconheceu a perda do jogador da seleção brasileira, mas afirmou que o Chelsea tem elenco suficiente para lidar com sua ausência. O Chelsea enfrentará o Liverpool na quarta-feira pelas oitavas de final da Copa da Liga e receberá o Manchester United pelo campeonato no sábado. (Reportagem de Karan Prashant Saxena, em Bengaluru)

item.title: Galípolo afirma não ser cotado para Fazenda e diz estar contente no cargo
item.description: O presidente do Banco Central, Gabriel Galípolo, disse nesta terça-feira não estar sendo cotado para assumir o Ministério da Fazenda no novo mandato do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, ressaltando que tem mandato na autarquia até 2028 e está muito contente no cargo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente do Banco Central, Gabriel Galípolo, disse nesta terça-feira não estar sendo cotado para assumir o Ministério da Fazenda no novo mandato do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, ressaltando que tem mandato na autarquia até 2028 e está muito contente no cargo. Em entrevista coletiva para comentar o relatório de estabilidade financeira da autarquia, Galípolo também afirmou que nomeações para a diretoria do BC, que tem dois cargos vagos desde o início do ano, são uma atribuição de Lula. O presidente do BC ainda afirmou que a autarquia não pode fazer comentários sobre o resultado das eleições. Perguntado sobre a estratégia de atuação do BC diante da forte volatilidade no mercado após a vitória eleitoral de Lula, ele se limitou a dizer que a autoridade monetária faz intervenção cambial quando observa disfuncionalidades. Em relação a possíveis efeitos inflacionários da aprovação do fim da escala de trabalho 6x1, Galípolo afirmou que o BC tem uma governança que incorpora impactos apenas conforme eles passam a ser observados. Ele ponderou que a percepção do mercado sobre medidas aprovadas afeta preços de ativos e esse efeito é incorporado nos modelos da autarquia.

item.title: Romania selects Thales for civil and military radar systems
item.description: Romania's defence ministry has selected French military equipment maker Thales to provide radar systems, supporting both civil and military airspace surveillance and approach and landing operations, the company said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Romania's defence ministry has selected French military equipment maker Thales (TCFP.PA) to provide radar systems, supporting both civil and military airspace surveillance and approach and landing operations, the company said on Tuesday. The systems will enhance the Romanian Air Force's ability to relocate operations and operate from alternative sites, reducing reliance on fixed airbase infrastructure and strengthening operational resilience. The Defence ministry intends to buy four such radar systems, which will be delivered to four Romanian Air Force locations by 2030. NATO member Romania shares a 614-km (381-mile) border with Ukraine and has repeatedly reported Russian drone incursions into its airspace since Moscow's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Romania has started [USN:L1N46306E TEXT:"shooting down drones"] that have been entering its airspace.

item.title: Chelsea's Joao Pedro out for 'a few weeks', says Alonso
item.description: Chelsea forward Joao Pedro is expected to be sidelined for a few weeks after suffering a thigh injury in training, manager Xabi Alonso said on Tuesday ahead of his side's League Cup clash with Liverpool.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chelsea forward Joao Pedro is expected to be sidelined for a few weeks after suffering a thigh injury in training, manager Xabi Alonso said on Tuesday ahead of his side's League Cup clash with Liverpool. The 25-year-old Brazilian missed Saturday's defeat by Tottenham Hotspur after picking up the injury during a training session on Friday "He has an injury on his thigh and he is going to be out for a few weeks," Alonso told reporters. "Let's see how many; we don't want to predict on that, but he's not ready for the next games." Pedro has made a bright start to the season, scoring five goals and providing three assists in seven appearances across all competitions Alonso acknowledged the loss of the Brazil international but said Chelsea had the depth to cope with his absence Chelsea will face Liverpool on Wednesday in the League Cup last 16 and host Manchester United in the league on Saturday

item.title: PSG's Kvaratskhelia undergoes successful ACL surgery
item.description: Paris St Germain's Khvicha Kvaratskhelia has successfully undergone surgery in Doha for a torn anterior cruciate ligament in his right knee, the French club said on Tuesday, a day after the Georgian finished sixth at the 2026 Ballon d'Or.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Paris St Germain's Khvicha Kvaratskhelia has successfully undergone surgery in Doha for a torn anterior cruciate ligament in his right knee, the French club said on Tuesday, a day after the Georgian finished sixth at the 2026 Ballon d'Or. Kvaratskhelia, 25, [USN:L4N4670OX TEXT:"twisted his right knee"] during last week's 4-2 Champions League victory over Barcelona and had to be helped off the pitch shortly before the hour mark. "He will now begin his rehabilitation," PSG said in a statement. ACL injuries typically require a recovery period of at least six months.

item.title: Swiss AI drug trial start-up receives funding from Spotify-backer Creandum
item.description: Swiss AI start-up Atlast Bio, which runs drug trials on virtual patients, has received $12.5 million in funding led by Swedish venture capital firm Creandum, an early backer of Spotify and Trade Republic, the company said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Swiss AI start-up Atlast Bio, which runs drug trials on virtual patients, has received $12.5 million in funding led by Swedish venture capital firm Creandum, an early backer of Spotify and Trade Republic, the company said on Tuesday. Atlas Bio is aiming to replace Phase II drug trials, which it says cost more than $100 million, take two to three years and see about 70% of drugs fail at that stage An AI foundation model, trained on about two million human RNA readouts, would replace these and animal testing with 12-week simulations, the company said Virtual trials can also evaluate drugs across multiple diseases simultaneously, something not feasible in conventional clinical trials, Atlas Bio added Results from a first trial are expected within 6 weeks Atlas Bio was founded by former Google employees alongside AI and pharmaceutical specialists

item.title: India's SBI Life posts profit rise on high-margin retail product boost
item.description: SBI Life Insurance reported a rise in quarterly profit on Tuesday, driven by a shift toward higher-margin retail products, even as growth was tempered by a slowdown in its group business.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: SBI Life Insurance (SBIL.NS) reported a rise in quarterly profit on Tuesday, driven by a shift toward higher-margin retail products, even as growth was tempered by a slowdown in its group business. The insurer reported a profit of 5.49 billion rupees ($57.71 million) for the quarter ended September 30, up from 4.95 billion rupees a year earlier. Analysts had expected SBI Life's profitability to improve as it shifted its focus to high-margin products such as traditional term insurance and non-participating policies. Non-participating policies pay benefits set out in the policy rather than returns linked to the insurer's profit. However, growth moderated after lower-margin large group contracts had boosted business in the previous quarter. Annualised premium equivalent sales, a key measure of new business, rose around 7% to 63.7 billion rupees, according to Reuters' calculation, compared with 36% growth in the preceding quarter. Value of new business, or expected profit from new policies sold, rose 12% to 18.6 billion rupees, according to a Reuters calculation, while its VNB margin improved to around 29%, up from near 28% a year earlier and 26.2% in the preceding quarter. The life insurer's net premium income rose over 8% to 268.78 billion rupees in the September quarter, while net commissions paid to insurance distributors rose 10.5%. India's insurance sector is set for major reforms as India's insurance regulator has [USN:L4N45F16M TEXT:"proposed overhauling commission rules"] to cap payouts and link them to product complexity, in an effort to curb costs that have ballooned since commission limits were relaxed in 2023. Analysts expect SBI Life to be the least impacted among major peers by commission reforms due to its better cost ratios. ($1 = 95.1350 Indian rupees)

item.title: Qatar says Iran needs to show good intentions for mediation efforts to succeed
item.description: Iran needs to show good intentions for mediation efforts to succeed, mediator Qatar said on Tuesday, after a delegation from the Gulf Arab country visited Tehran earlier this week in an effort to de-escalate regional tensions in coordination with the United States.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Iran needs to show good intentions for mediation efforts to succeed, mediator Qatar said on Tuesday, after a delegation from the Gulf Arab country visited Tehran earlier this week in an effort to de-escalate regional tensions in coordination with the United States. A spokesperson for the Qatari Foreign Ministry told a press briefing that Iran should stop threats against Arab Gulf states and open the Strait of Hormuz to show good intentions. Qatar, along with Pakistan, has been mediating between Washington and Tehran in an effort to end the US-Israeli war on Iran that has disrupted global shipping and oil supplies, and spilled over across other parts of the Middle East. Top officials from Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan also met Iranian officials in Tehran on Monday in an effort to de-escalate the conflict, as Yemen's Houthis launched [USN:S8N44700P TEXT:"new attacks on Saudi Arabia"] and Egypt [USN:S8N44701K TEXT:"approved defence support"] for the Gulf kingdom. Tensions between Washington and Tehran have sharpened recently, with President Donald Trump saying on Friday the US[USN:S0N45A05U TEXT:" may strike Iran again"]. Iranian security officials told Reuters Tehran had drawn up detailed plans to [USN:L6N46816Q TEXT:"attack Gulf undersea cables"] if the US and Israel attack again.

item.title: US new home sales fall in September; median house price drops from year ago
item.description: Sales of new US single-family homes fell in September, partially reversing the prior month's jump, as higher mortgage rates because of the Middle East conflict depressed demand.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Sales of new US single-family homes fell in September, partially reversing the prior month's jump, as higher mortgage rates because of the Middle East conflict depressed demand. New home sales slipped 0.6% to a seasonally adjusted annualized rate of 676,000 units last month, the Commerce Department's Census Bureau said on Tuesday. Data for August was revised lower to show sales rising to a rate of 680,000 units instead of the previously reported 684,000 units. Economists polled by Reuters had forecast home sales declining to a rate of 650,000 units. New home sales are counted at the closing of a contract, making them the most timely data on housing demand, though they account for a small share of US home sales. They dropped in the Midwest and South regions, but soared in the Northeast and West. Sales declined 5.3% on a year-over-year basis in September. The average rate on a 30-year fixed-rate mortgage has surged by more than 130 basis points since the US and Israel attacked Iran at the end of February. It averaged 7.32% last week, data from mortgage finance firm Freddie Mac showed. Higher mortgage rates have helped to fan what economists describe as an affordability crisis, a theme that has dominated campaign messaging ahead of next Tuesday's midterm elections. A National Association of Home Builders survey last week showed builders' expectations of home sales over the next six months tumbled to the lowest level since April 2012, excluding the plunge early in the COVID-19 pandemic. The median new house price dropped 3.9% to a still-high $400,400 in September from a year earlier, likely the combination of weak demand and developers cutting prices. Most of the homes sold in September were priced below $499,999. The supply of new houses on the market fell to 476,000 units from 481,000 units in August. At September's sales pace, it would take 8.4 months to clear the inventory, down from 8.5 months in August. The still-elevated housing inventory is also discouraging builders from breaking new ground on single-family housing projects. The government reported last week a sharp drop in [USN:L1N4650SY TEXT:"single-family housing starts"] in September and slump in permits for future construction to a 3-1/2-year low.

item.title: Russia jails man for 13 years after Binance revealed Ukraine donations
item.description: A Russian IT specialist has been sentenced to 13 years in jail on charges of financing terrorism after the cryptocurrency exchange Binance passed details to Moscow of his donations to Ukrainian fundraising campaigns.
item.dc:creator: Anton Zverev
item.content:encoded: A Russian IT specialist has been sentenced to 13 years in jail on charges of financing terrorism after the cryptocurrency exchange Binance passed details to Moscow of his donations to Ukrainian fundraising campaigns. The 2nd Western District Military Court on Monday convicted 49-year-old Yuri Belenkiy and sentenced him to three years in prison plus 10 years in a strict-regime penal colony, according to a court statement. Belenkiy, who has a Bulgarian residence permit, was detained in September last year when he flew to Moscow for a visit, and has been in custody since. He denied the charges, according to the court. Belenkiy had responded to online appeals to help buy medical equipment for Ukrainian soldiers by transferring money from his Binance accounts to the Ukrainian military , according to Russian law enforcement documents seen by Reuters. Some payments went to the Azov Brigade or Azov Regiment, a particular bete noire for Moscow. BINANCE ACCEPTED RUSSIAN INVESTIGATORS' REQUEST The same documents showed that Binance provided Russian investigators with Belenkiy's transaction history last year, including records of transfers to Ukrainian fundraising campaigns, in response to a Russian request, and that the records were instrumental in prosecuting him, [USN:L8N44B0VN TEXT:"Reuters reported in August."] According to the records, Belenkiy sent more than $700 to the Ukrainian military in response to an online appeal by Arkady Babchenko, an exiled Russian critic of the Kremlin who supports Ukraine. "The response from Binance serves as key evidence in the criminal case against Belenkiy," said Yevgeny Smirnov, a lawyer with the rights group First Department, which assists people facing politically motivated prosecutions in Russia. Rights advocates who monitor such prosecutions say dozens of Russians have been convicted in recent years for donations made through cryptocurrency platforms to causes that authorities later classified as extremist or terrorist. Many used cryptocurrency because they believed it would keep their identities secret. Asked on Tuesday about the sentence, Binance referred Reuters to a previous statement in which it said the exchange "does not make or enforce the laws of any jurisdiction, determine charges, or decide how any government uses information in legal proceedings". It said it does not comment on confidential law-enforcement requests or individual cases. A lawyer who specialises in crypto regulation, Mike Bystrov, told Reuters in August that Binance, which left Russia in 2023 following Moscow's full-scale invasion of Ukraine and the subsequent imposition of Western sanctions, had been under no obligation to provide Belenkiy's data. He said it might, in fact, have had obligations under European Union data-protection law not to do so because of Belenkiy's Bulgarian residency status.

item.title: Gases de efecto invernadero alcanzan máximos históricos y aumentarían con El Niño: agencia de la ONU
item.description: Los gases de efecto invernadero en la atmósfera subieron a máximos históricos en 2025, lo que podría provocar un mayor calentamiento del planeta y dar lugar a fenómenos climáticos más extremos, indicó la Organización Meteorológica Mundial (OMM) en un informe publicado el martes.
item.dc:creator: Olivia Le Poidevin
item.content:encoded: Los gases de efecto invernadero en la atmósfera subieron a máximos históricos en 2025, lo que podría provocar un mayor calentamiento del planeta y dar lugar a fenómenos climáticos más extremos, indicó la Organización Meteorológica Mundial (OMM) en un informe publicado el martes. La concentración promedio global de CO₂ en la atmósfera alcanzó las 426,8 partes por millón en 2025, lo que supone aproximadamente un 153% del nivel preindustrial de 1750, según el informe. El nivel aumentó en 2,8 ppm con respecto del año anterior, un incremento anual superior al promedio de la última década. Las concentraciones de otros gases de efecto invernadero importantes —el metano y el óxido nitroso— alcanzaron máximos históricos en 2025, situándose en el 267% y el 126% de los niveles preindustriales, respectivamente. El informe mide la cantidad de gas que se acumula en la atmósfera, no las nuevas emisiones anuales. La OMM compartirá estas conclusiones con los negociadores en la COP31, la conferencia de la ONU sobre el clima que se celebrará en Antalya, en Turquía, en noviembre, y advirtió de que un fenómeno de El Niño de gran intensidad podría hacer que las concentraciones aumentaran aún más este año. "Cada parte por millón adicional cuenta, ya que retiene más calor. En efecto, estamos sobrecargando el océano y la atmósfera", dijo Ko Barrett, secretario general adjunto de la OMM. "Esto significa que las olas de calor, los ciclones tropicales y las tormentas se están intensificando más rápido de lo que nos preparaban nuestras referencias históricas". Este año, algunas partes del mundo, incluida Europa, han registrado temperaturas estivales abrasadoras, además hubo inundaciones devastadoras en Asia y otros lugares. EL FENÓMENO DE EL NIÑO PROBABLEMENTE AGRAVARÁ EL PROBLEMA La OMM señaló que esperaba que las concentraciones de CO₂ aumentaran aún más este año debido a la quema de combustibles fósiles y a la llegada de un potente fenómeno de El Niño, que provocará un clima más seco y dificultará que los sumideros de carbono absorban las emisiones. La OMM también expresó su preocupación por el hexafluoruro de azufre, o SF₆, un gas de efecto invernadero ampliamente utilizado en equipos eléctricos, y señaló que su aumento en 2025 alcanzó un máximo histórico. El potencial de calentamiento global del SF₆ es más de 24.000 veces superior al del CO₂ y puede permanecer en la atmósfera durante más de 1.000 años. La organización también señaló el aumento de las concentraciones de hidrógeno, que se incrementaron un 5,3% entre 2010 y 2024. Aunque el hidrógeno no es un gas de efecto invernadero, las fugas de las infraestructuras usadas para su producción, transporte y almacenamiento pueden afectar a la química atmosférica y contribuir indirectamente al calentamiento. El hidrógeno producido a partir de electricidad renovable puede utilizarse como combustible con bajas emisiones de carbono para el transporte. La OMM señaló que tanto las fugas de hidrógeno como la larga persistencia del SF₆ podrían socavar algunos de los beneficios climáticos de la transición energética mundial. "La transición energética es esencial y bienvenida, pero, como ocurre con toda transición, debe llevarse a cabo de forma inteligente y basándose en observaciones medioambientales", dijo Barrett.

item.title: El S&P 500 y el Nasdaq suben mientras el petróleo cede a la espera de la decisión de la Fed
item.description: Los índices S&P 500 y Nasdaq subían el martes, ya que el descenso de los precios del petróleo favorecía el apetito por el riesgo a la espera de la decisión sobre política monetaria de la Reserva Federal de esta semana, mientras que los inversores también analizaban una serie de resultados empresariales clave.
item.dc:creator: Shashwat Chauhan, Utkarsh Hathi
item.content:encoded: Los índices S&P 500 y Nasdaq subían el martes, ya que el descenso de los precios del petróleo favorecía el apetito por el riesgo a la espera de la decisión sobre política monetaria de la Reserva Federal de esta semana, mientras que los inversores también analizaban una serie de resultados empresariales clave. * A las 1444 GMT, el Promedio Industrial Dow Jones Industrial (.DJI) cedía 58,59 puntos, o un 0,11%, a 52.302 unidades; el S&P 500 (.SPX) ganaba 25,52 puntos, o un 0,33%, a 7.702,29 unidades; y el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) mejoraba 190,55 puntos, o un 0,73%, a 26.359,93 unidades. * EL mercado espera que la Fed mantenga las tasas de interés sin cambios el miércoles, tras el alza del mes pasado, aunque se prevén al menos dos subidas más de aquí a mediados de 2027, ya que los principales indicadores de inflación siguen elevados en medio del actual conflicto con Irán. * El crudo Brent bajaba por segunda sesión consecutiva en una jornada volátil, aunque seguía cerca de su nivel más alto desde finales de abril. * La caída del 3,4% en las acciones del fabricante de pinturas Sherwin-Williams (SHW.N) , tras unos resultados trimestrales por debajo de lo esperado, lastraba al Dow. * Seis de los 11 principales sectores del S&P 500 registraban mejoras, con el sector tecnológico (.SPLRCT) a la cabeza, mientras que el energético (.SPNY) se quedaba rezagado. * Las acciones de gran capitalización y de crecimiento registraban resultados mixtos. Los papeles de Tesla (TSLA.O) sumaban cerca de un 3%, sumándose a la subida de más del 5% de la sesión anterior. * Meta (META.O) caía un 1,1% tras aumentar su mayor ronda de financiación de capital hasta la fecha a 97.500 millones de dólares para financiar la expansión de la inteligencia artificial. La iniciativa también ha despertado un interés de hasta 5.000 millones de dólares en total por parte de Nvidia (NVDA.O) , Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.O) y Broadcom (AVGO.O) .

item.title: Mbappé tenta amenizar irritação na China após comentário sobre meme de Mao
item.description: O capitão da seleção francesa, Kylian Mbappé, pediu desculpas nesta terça-feira, depois que marcas chinesas romperam laços com ele por causa de comentário referente ao falecido líder chinês Mao Tsé-Tung — um episódio que evidencia a rapidez com que celebridades internacionais podem enfrentar problemas em um mercado fundamental.
item.dc:creator: Casey Hall, Clare Jim
item.content:encoded: O capitão da seleção francesa, Kylian Mbappé, pediu desculpas nesta terça-feira, depois que marcas chinesas romperam laços com ele por causa de comentário referente ao falecido líder chinês Mao Tsé-Tung — um episódio que evidencia a rapidez com que celebridades internacionais podem enfrentar problemas em um mercado fundamental. Em um vídeo que surgiu na internet na segunda-feira, ouve-se Mbappé dizer que o meme mais engraçado que ele já tinha visto de si mesmo era aquele em que seu rosto havia sido colado no de “um cara — acho que é um ditador chinês”, em uma aparente referência a um meme de Mbappé sobreposto a uma imagem de Mao, um dos vários que usam o rosto do jogador de futebol e de outras figuras históricas. "Durante uma entrevista recente, reagi a uma imagem minha", disse Mbappé em um comunicado. "Meu comentário foi imprudente, e agora entendo que ele magoou muitas pessoas na China e em comunidades chinesas ao redor do mundo." "Peço desculpas a todos que se sentiram ofendidos pelas minhas palavras", acrescentou. "Essa, de forma alguma, foi a minha intenção. Tenho um profundo respeito pelo povo chinês e por sua história, e sinto muito, sinceramente." Na China, sátiras ou piadas sobre Mao, o líder que governou o país de 1949 até sua morte em 1976, são consideradas desrespeitosas e continuam sendo um tabu social. “Uma observação sobre um meme da internet provocou uma reação negativa entre seus fãs chineses, ameaçou suas lucrativas relações comerciais e serviu como um forte lembrete dos limites da influência das celebridades”, afirmou o veículo de mídia estatal China Daily. O episódio faz de Mbappé — uma das estrelas do esporte mais proeminentes do mundo, que mantém parcerias com empresas que vão da marca de roupas esportivas On Holding (49G.BN) à rede de hotéis Accor (ACCP.PA) e à fabricante de brinquedos Lego — o mais recente a cometer um deslize na China. Outras empresas e organizações de destaque que já despertaram a ira de Pequim, dos internautas e da mídia chinesa incluem a marca de moda Dolce & Gabbana, a fabricante suíça de relógios Swatch e a NBA, a liga nacional de basquete dos Estados Unidos. Muitos veículos de mídia chineses condenaram na terça-feira as declarações de Mbappé, mas não as repetiram. “O que ele disse? Muitos chineses preferem não repetir”, afirmou o jornal Global Times, apoiado pelo Estado. “A mensagem dos consumidores chineses é clara: o respeito não é opcional; ninguém pode lucrar com a China enquanto a desrespeita. Nem pensar.” Marcas como as empresas de laticínios Mengniu (2319.HK) e Shanghai Milkground Food Tech (600882.SS) , bem como a Eastroc Beverage (605499.SS) , afirmaram que estavam suspendendo toda a cooperação com Mbappé, que joga pelo Real Madrid, com efeito imediato. As empresas afirmaram que “se opõem firmemente e têm tolerância zero a quaisquer palavras ou ações que ofendam os sentimentos do povo chinês”. A televisão estatal chinesa suspendeu a transmissão de todas as partidas e eventos envolvendo a LaLiga e Mbappé, e todos os anúncios com a participação de Mbappé foram removidos, informou na terça-feira o veículo de mídia apoiado pelo Estado, The Paper. (Reportagem de Aadi Nair, em Bengaluru, e Clare Jim, em Hong Kong; Reportagem adicional de Jacob Gronholt-Pedersen, em Copenhagen; Helen Reid, em Londres, e Alessandro Parodi, em Paris)

item.title: Swatch to NBA: Brands that have faced backlash in China
item.description: Kylian Mbappe was dropped by multiple Chinese brands in late October over comments referring to the late Chinese leader Mao Zedong, the latest celebrity to face backlash over such missteps.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Kylian Mbappe was [USN:L5N46D0O8 TEXT:"dropped"] by multiple Chinese brands in late October over comments referring to the late Chinese leader Mao Zedong, the latest celebrity to face backlash over such missteps. In China, jokes or satire about the country's founding father remain a social taboo. Global consumer-facing brands doing business in China have also come under scrutiny over the years, from advertisements perceived as insulting Chinese culture to assumptions over geopolitical status and human rights issues. Below are some of the most notable brands that have faced backlash over their ads or views on geopolitical and human rights questions. ADS: DOLCE & GABBANA The fashion brand [USN:KCN1NQ142 TEXT:"cancelled a Shanghai show"] in 2018 after a backlash from Chinese celebrities and on social media over ads that showed a Chinese woman struggling to eat pizza and spaghetti with chopsticks. SWATCH (UHR.S) The watchmaker in August 2025 apologized and [USN:L4N3UA02G TEXT:"took down ads"] featuring an Asian male model pulling the corners of his eyes up and backwards in a "slanted eye" pose. GEOPOLITICS: COACH, GIVENCHY Chinese brand ambassadors of fashion labels from Coach and Givenchy [USN:L4N2580MG TEXT:"cut ties with the companies"] in 2019 over products they said went against China's sovereignty by identifying Taiwan and Hong Kong as countries. MARRIOTT (MAR.O) Marriott [USN:L1N1P609V TEXT:"apologized"] in 2018 after a customer questionnaire listed Tibet, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan as separate countries, provoking an outcry and triggering an investigation by Shanghai authorities. CHRISTIAN DIOR (DIOR.PA) An image shown during a Dior presentation that excluded Taiwan from a map of China [USN:KBN1WW095 TEXT:"sparked criticism"] on social media in 2019. The luxury brand apologized and reaffirmed its support for the "One China" principle. VERSACE Brand ambassador Yang Mi ended her partnership with the luxury group in 2019 after a Versace T-shirt was widely criticized for identifying Hong Kong and Macau as countries. The group said it had stopped selling and destroyed the T-shirts. VICTORIA'S SECRET (VSXY.N) In 2017, model Gigi Hadid and singer Katy Perry [USN:KBN1DK0OQ TEXT:"were unable to attend"] the underwear brand's Shanghai fashion show following criticism over their actions seen as supportive of Taiwan. MERCEDES (MBGn.DE) The carmaker apologised to Chinese people in 2018 after [USN:KBN1FQ1FO TEXT:"quoting the Dalai Lama"] in an Instagram post alongside one of the brand's luxury cars. HUMAN RIGHTS: BURBERRY (BRBY.L) , ADIDAS (ADSGn.DE) , NIKE (NKE.N) , H&M (HMb.ST) In 2021, fashion giants were caught up in online attacks and boycotts of Western brands over past statements saying they would not source cotton from Xinjiang after reports of human rights abuses against Uyghur Muslims. Beijing denies any such abuses. Burberry [USN:L4N2LO0PZ TEXT:"lost a brand ambassador"] and its hallmark tartan design was scrubbed from a popular video game, while H&M [USN:L4N2M025H TEXT:"became the focal point"] of the consumer boycott and was removed from major Chinese online platforms. Chinese actor Wang Yibo [USN:KBN2BH08O TEXT:"ended his collaboration"] with sportswear brand Nike, while sales of rival Adidas [USN:FWN2PB1DW TEXT:"were also hit by boycotts"]. NBA In 2019, a Houston Rockets official posted a tweet in support of Hong Kong democracy protests, angering Beijing, Chinese fans and the team's partners in a key market. The NBA said in a statement it [USN:KCN1WL04T TEXT:"regretted the tweet"], which sparked criticism in the US over what some US senators called censoring of free speech. The incident rocked the NBA's decades-long partnership with Chinese state broadcaster CCTV, leading to an 18-month blackout that ended in 2022. The league had also staged several preseason games in China but the saga forced that tradition into a six-year hiatus, with the league [USN:L1N3LM0V6 TEXT:"returning to play"] in Macao in 2025.

item.description: La cosecha de soja de Brasil para la temporada 2026/27 podría reducirse a 163,6 millones de toneladas métricas en un escenario de El Niño intenso, frente a los 181,2 millones de toneladas que se obtendrían en condiciones climáticas neutras, según las previsiones de un estudio de Serasa Experian publicado el martes.

item.content:encoded: La cosecha de soja de Brasil para la temporada 2026/27 podría reducirse a 163,6 millones de toneladas métricas en un escenario de El Niño intenso, frente a los 181,2 millones de toneladas que se obtendrían en condiciones climáticas neutras, según las previsiones de un estudio de Serasa Experian publicado el martes. El estudio se basó en episodios históricos de El Niño en las regiones brasileñas productoras de soja para estimar el posible impacto en la producción. Brasil es el mayor productor y exportador de soja del mundo. Las pérdidas potenciales se concentrarían en las regiones productoras de soja del Centro-Oeste del país, según el estudio. Las pérdidas en el estado de Mato Grosso podrían alcanzar los 9,7 millones de toneladas en un escenario de El Niño intenso. Las pérdidas en el estado de Goiás podrían alcanzar los 4 millones de toneladas.

item.title: Indian lenders defer dollar debt sale plan as rates turn expensive
item.description: At least four Indian state-run and private lenders are deferring their plans to tap the US dollar debt market as a recent spike in Treasury yields and hedging costs has made this proposition expensive, bank officials and merchant bankers said.
item.dc:creator: Dharamraj Dhutia
item.content:encoded: At least four Indian state-run and private lenders are deferring their plans to tap the US dollar debt market as a recent spike in Treasury yields and hedging costs has made this proposition expensive, bank officials and merchant bankers said. [USN:L4N44Z0MU TEXT:"Canara Bank"] (CNBK.NS) , [USN:L4N45V05U TEXT:"Punjab National Bank"] (PNBK.NS) (PNB) and Bank of India (BOI.NS) had plans to raise as much as $2.5 billion through the sale of dollar debt under the central bank's subsidised hedging facility, and had also initiated talks, but ultimately decided to not go ahead with the issuances, the bankers said. They spoke on the condition of anonymity as they are not authorised to speak to the media. The 10-year US yield has climbed 25 bps to around 5% in the last two months, while the rupee has declined 0.8% in the same period. This, along with a jump in hedging costs, has made dollar fundraising expensive compared to rupee-denominated funds, bankers said. Currently, the all-in dollar debt cost for a state-run lender would be around 70 to 100 basis points over a one-year rupee funding, they said. Canara Bank MD & CEO Brajesh Kumar Singh told Reuters the bank decided to not proceed with the planned dollar bond sale as the rates have shot up quite sharply. Punjab National Bank and Bank of India did not reply to Reuters' emails seeking comment. Heavier supply from Indian lenders has contributed to wider secondary spreads and higher new-issue premiums, while the recent risk-off move across Asian credit markets has added further pressure, making the cost of new dollar issuance relatively high at this juncture, Lim Ze Hao, associate director, APAC financials at CreditSights, said. "We would still expect some of the lenders currently in the pipeline to come to market once dollar funding conditions improve, particularly given the incentive to make use of the RBI facility before it expires," Lim said. The Reserve Bank of India has allowed banks and state-run companies to raise funds overseas and access a subsidised hedging facility between June and December, lowering the cost of managing currency risk. Indian lenders have already raised $13 billion through dollar bonds under this scheme, with five state-run banks raising an aggregate of $3.5 billion through private placements and public issues. Smaller private lender Karur Vysya Bank (KARU.NS) also considered a dollar debt sale, but is waiting for favourable pricing. "Maybe in the next one month or so, we will try to conclude some deal if the pricing and money is favourable," MD and CEO Ramesh Babu said at a post-earnings conference call earlier this month.

item.title: Putellas culmina un extraordinario regreso con su tercer Balón de Oro e iguala el récord de Bonmatí
item.description: Hace cuatro años, Alexia Putellas parecía intocable: la deslumbrante capitana del Barcelona que se convirtió en la primera mujer en ganar dos Balones de Oro femeninos consecutivos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Hace cuatro años, Alexia Putellas parecía intocable: la deslumbrante capitana del Barcelona que se convirtió en la primera mujer en ganar dos Balones de Oro femeninos consecutivos. Después llegaron una devastadora lesión de rodilla, meses de rehabilitación y una pregunta incómoda: ¿había dejado ya atrás su mejor momento la mejor jugadora del mundo? El lunes por la noche, la respuesta fue contundente. La centrocampista española recuperó el máximo reconocimiento individual del fútbol femenino al conquistar su tercer Balón de Oro, con el que igualó el récord y se unió a su compatriota Aitana Bonmatí como las únicas jugadoras que han levantado el trofeo tres veces. "A todos los niños y niñas del mundo: si les gusta el fútbol y quieren jugar al fútbol, jueguen al fútbol", dijo en su discurso de aceptación. "No importa si eres niño o niña. No importa de dónde vengas. No escuches a quien te diga que no puedes hacerlo. Cree en ti". Para muchas jugadoras, el premio representaría la culminación de su carrera. Para Putellas, de 32 años, parecía más bien cerrar un círculo. Para el final de la temporada 2021/2022, se había consolidado como la gran figura del fútbol femenino, con dos Balones de Oro con1secutivos y al frente de un Barcelona al que había llevado a la cima del fútbol europeo, tras conquistar su primera Liga de Campeones en 2021. Entonces, todo se detuvo. Días antes del debut de España en la Eurocopa, Putellas sufrió una rotura del ligamento cruzado anterior, una lesión que no sólo la dejó fuera del torneo, sino que amenazó con alterar el rumbo de su carrera. La rehabilitación la mantuvo alejada de los terrenos de juego durante casi un año, y su regreso no supuso recuperar de inmediato su mejor versión. Llegó al Mundial femenino de 2023 todavía en busca de su plenitud física y, más adelante, volvió a operarse de la rodilla tras otro contratiempo. RECONSTRUCCIÓN Quizá por primera vez en su carrera, Putellas se vio obligada a perseguir el nivel que ella misma había establecido. Mientras el Barcelona seguía acumulando títulos y surgían nuevos nombres, los focos se desplazaron hacia otras protagonistas. En lugar de aceptar un papel secundario, se reconstruyó. Poco a poco recuperó la precisión en su juego, después la confianza y, finalmente, la influencia que la había convertido en la jugadora dominante del fútbol femenino. La pasada temporada fue la prueba más clara hasta entonces. Putellas conquistó su décimo título de la Liga F con el Barcelona, además de su décima Copa de la Reina y su cuarta Liga de Campeones, y marcó 20 goles en todas las competiciones. En julio se incorporó al London City Lionesses, de la Women's Super League inglesa, después de 14 años en el Barça. Asumió así el reto de liderar el ambicioso proyecto de su propietaria, Michele Kang, para romper el orden establecido en la máxima categoría inglesa. Putellas también ha aprovechado su notoriedad para acercar el fútbol femenino a nuevos públicos, especialmente mediante el lanzamiento de su canal de YouTube, ElevenTV. La plataforma adquirió los derechos para emitir partidos de la WSL en España. El premio del lunes significó más que otra temporada sobresaliente. Fue el reconocimiento a su regreso tras el desafío más serio de su carrera y la confirmación de que una de las jugadoras que han marcado el fútbol moderno había recuperado su lugar en la cima.

item.title: When the model becomes the crime scene — Responding when an AI model is compromised
item.description: Michael A. Gold of Jeffer Mangels & Mitchell LLP explains why AI-native security incidents require a different response and outlines preparedness measures for a new type of incident response plan.
item.dc:creator: Michael A. Gold
item.content:encoded: AI-native data breaches and security incidents are categorically different from conventional data breaches and they demand categorically different investigative techniques, legal analysis, and governance responses. Conventional breach response paradigms work poorly or not at all in AI-native incidents involving model manipulation, data poisoning, prompt injection, model theft, and deep fake social engineering. System logs, file-integrity checks, and user activity data are not much help when no reliable forensic records are generated in the LLM system compromise. And good luck trying to obtain helpful information from the AI vendor, whose contract may be silent as to forensic cooperation rights specific to the AI licensed to your organization. This article highlights the key subject-matter areas an AI-native incident response plan must address and concrete preparedness measures that should be considered when developing such a plan. UNDERSTANDING THE AI-NATIVE THREAT LANDSCAPE Traditional data breaches follow a broadly understood pattern: a threat actor gains unauthorized access, exfiltrates data, and the organization responds by scoping the compromise, notifying affected individuals, and remediating the vulnerability. AI-native breaches depart from this model in fundamental ways and fall into two distinct threat types. The first involves AI-powered attacks, in which adversaries leverage AI to conduct reconnaissance, design sophisticated phishing campaigns, automate vulnerability exploitation, or evade detection with adaptive malware. The second involves attacks targeting an organization's AI resources themselves — its training data, model weights, inference pipelines, and outputs. The latter creates challenges that are not addressed by conventional breach response protocols. In this second category, a threat actor's objective may not be to steal personal records or disable a system at all. Instead, the goal may be to poison training data so that a model produces subtly corrupted outputs, extract proprietary model parameters through crafted queries, manipulate model behavior through adversarial inputs, or exfiltrate the intellectual property embedded in the model itself. A modern incident response plan must account for each of these attack vectors. ADAPTING FORENSIC INVESTIGATIONS An effective plan must acknowledge that AI-native forensic investigations differ fundamentally from conventional practices. Traditional forensic investigators examine network logs, endpoint telemetry, access control records, and file system artifacts to reconstruct the timeline of unauthorized access. AI-native breaches confound this paradigm in several critical respects. First, the "crime scene" is fundamentally different. When an adversary poisons training data, the compromise may have occurred weeks or months before anomalous behavior is discovered. The forensic question shifts from "what was taken" to "what was altered, and how has that alteration propagated through the model's learned representations." Second, the evidence is probabilistic rather than deterministic. A compromised model does not produce a clean log entry showing tampering; its outputs shift in subtle, statistical ways difficult to distinguish from normal model drift. Third, model extraction attacks present unique evidentiary challenges because the attacker uses the system exactly as designed, merely at a scale and with a query sophistication that enables approximation of the model's internal logic. Fourth, "scope" in an AI-native breach is far more ambiguous — a poisoned model may generate flawed decisions affecting thousands of individuals without any single "record" being compromised. An incident response plan must adapt the organization's forensic capabilities to include practitioners with machine learning expertise alongside traditional digital forensics credentials, whether through internal hiring or retainer arrangements with specialized firms. ADDRESSING LEGAL COMPLEXITY The plan must also address the significant legal uncertainties AI-native breaches present. Breach notification statutes are generally triggered by unauthorized acquisition of specified personal information — Social Security numbers, financial account credentials, or protected health information. An AI-native breach may not involve the compromise of personal information in any recognizable statutory sense. If an adversary poisons a model or extracts model weights, no individual's personal data has been accessed, yet the harm may be substantial. Existing notification frameworks provide little clarity on whether such incidents trigger disclosure obligations, leaving organizations caught between over-notification and under-notification. The regulatory landscape implicated by an AI-native breach is fragmented, overlapping, and often contradictory. The EU AI Act's serious incident reporting provisions are oriented toward safety harms rather than the confidentiality and integrity concerns that characterize a security breach. In the United States, a single AI-native incident may implicate state attorneys general, the FTC, sector-specific regulators such as the OCC or FDIC, the HHS Office for Civil Rights, and the SEC — each with different statutory mandates and materiality thresholds. No single federal framework governs AI security incidents, and the emerging patchwork of state AI legislation adds further compliance layers. An incident response plan must map these overlapping obligations in advance and establish decision trees for notification analysis. AI-native breaches also raise distinct litigation and intellectual property challenges. Proving causation between a model compromise and a specific harm requires expert testimony bridging machine learning and legal standards of proof. Model weights may qualify as trade secrets, but proving misappropriation requires showing that the extracted approximation is substantially derived from the original — a showing that may demand novel technical methodologies. AI systems also frequently depend on third-party components, and a supply chain breach raises complex questions of contractual liability and indemnification that vendor agreements drafted for conventional breaches may not adequately address. CONCRETE PREPAREDNESS MEASURES An incident response plan for AI-native threats should include several specific measures. It should include playbooks addressing model integrity verification, training data provenance investigation, and the particular notification challenges these incidents present. Organizations should conduct tabletop exercises modeling AI-native breach scenarios, testing notification decision-making frameworks against fact patterns that do not fit within existing statutory triggers. Contracts with AI vendors and partners should be reviewed to ensure they address model integrity, supply chain compromise scenarios, and cooperation obligations when an incident affects shared AI resources. Last, and assuredly not least, organizations must avoid self-delusion when assessing the risks of AI-native security incidents. Ignoring or underestimating obvious risks in the world of conventional cyber threats is bad enough. Doing so in the age of AI is a sure recipe for disaster. CONCLUSION The frameworks that served the industry well for two decades of conventional breach response remain necessary, but they are no longer sufficient. Organizations that invest now in building AI-specific incident response capabilities — spanning forensic expertise, legal analysis, regulatory mapping, and supply chain governance — will be far better positioned to respond effectively when an AI-native breach occurs.

item.title: Four UK men on trial accused of raping or assaulting drugged woman
item.description: Four British men went on trial on Tuesday for raping or sexually abusing a woman who had been advertised online, drugged and filmed by her then-husband, with prosecutors warning the jury that they would "see videos of things you cannot then unsee".
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Four British men went on trial on Tuesday for raping or sexually abusing a woman who had been advertised online, drugged and filmed by her then-husband, with prosecutors warning the jury that they would "see videos of things you cannot then unsee". Philip Young, 50, earlier this year pleaded guilty to several offences committed over more than a decade against his ex-wife Joanne Young, who has waived her legal right to anonymity. Four other men who prosecutors say raped or sexually assaulted her between 2016 and 2023 are now standing trial at Winchester Crown Court for offences they allegedly committed with Philip Young. Connor Sanderson-Doyle, 32, denies one count of sexual assault and one count of assault by penetration; Richard Wilkins, 62, denies one count of rape and one count of assault by penetration; Norman Macksoni, 48, denies one count of rape; and Mohammed Hassan, 38, denies one count of sexual assault. "This case is, in effect, about whether it is ever reasonable to have sex or to begin to have sexual contact with an unknown woman without checking with her first," prosecutor Sarah Jones said. She said Philip Young posted images online of Joanne Young, tied to her bed and blindfolded, as he "sought strangers to come and sleep with his wife – any age, any race". "He presented it as a kink for both of them but there was no information from Joanne herself to support that," Jones added. Without Joanne Young's knowledge or consent, Jones said, Philip Young had regularly drugged her and invited strangers who responded to online posts to have sex with her, watching and filming while it happened. Police found those videos after an account linked to Philip Young posted bestiality images online in 2023 and his devices were seized. Jones said that Joanne Young had consented to Philip Young's preference for her to be blindfolded and restrained during sex, but one evening around 2023 woke up to discover a stranger was in the room. Philip Young said on that occasion he had invited someone to watch the couple having sex, but after his arrest police found videos of strangers sexually assaulting or raping Joanne Young, the prosecutor said. "You are going to see videos of things you cannot then unsee and may find you can't forget," Jones told the jury. The trial is expected to last up to four weeks.

item.title: WTA roundup: Naomi Osaka survives opener in Tokyo
item.description: Home favorite Naomi Osaka held off Italy's Jasmine Paolini for a 6-3, 7-6 (4) first-round win on Tuesday at the Toray Pan Pacific Open in Tokyo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Home favorite Naomi Osaka held off Italy's Jasmine Paolini for a 6-3, 7-6 (4) first-round win on Tuesday at the Toray Pan Pacific Open in Tokyo. The seventh-seeded Osaka, who won the WTA 500 tournament in 2019 and was runner-up in 2016 and 2018, saved seven of nine break points and struck 30 winners. Up next for the four-time Grand Slam winner is 18-year-old Mia Pohankova of Slovakia, a 6-1, 6-4 winner against Czech Tereza Valentova. Australia's Maya Joint defeated No. 6 Sorana Cirstea of Romania 6-3, 7-6 (4) in the only other match involving a seeded player. Also advancing to the second round were Aliaksandra Sasnovich of Belarus, Leylah Fernandez of Canada, Yulia Putintseva of Kazakhstan, Cristina Busa of Spain and Russia's Ekaterina Alexandrova. Guangzhou Open No. 2 seed Janice Tjen of Indonesia needed only 58 minutes to complete a 6-2, 6-2 first-round win against Polina Kudermetova of Uzbekistan at the WTA 250 tournament in China. Tjen won 23 of 26 points on her first serve, never faced a break point and had only four unforced errors compared to 29 for her opponent. She will meet Britain's Harriet Dart in the second round. No. 4 Lilli Tagger of Austria eliminated 46-year-old Venus Williams 6-2, 6-2 and No. 6 Zeynep Sonmez of Turkey outlasted Spain's Sara Sorribes Tormo 6-1, 4-6, 6-2. Ukraine's Dayana Yastremska knocked out No. 8 Katie Volynets 7-5, 1-6, 7-6 (7) in 2 hours and 44 minutes. Unseeded winners advancing to the second round included China's Xinran Sun, American Claire Liu, Spain's Kaitlin Quevedo, Poland's Magda Linette and Switzerland's Jil Teichmann. --Field Level Media

item.title: AI financing driving private credit growth as refinancing risks rise, Moody’s says
item.description: High levels of borrowing to fund AI infrastructure is expanding private credit beyond traditional corporate lending, but a wave of loans coming due in the next few years could leave weaker borrowers struggling to refinance, Moody's Ratings said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: High levels of borrowing to fund AI infrastructure is expanding private credit beyond traditional corporate lending, but a wave of loans coming due in the next few years could leave weaker borrowers struggling to refinance, Moody's Ratings said on Tuesday. Here are more details: The ratings agency said AI financing needs now extend beyond data-center construction to land, power, semiconductors, graphics processing units and tensor processing units Moody's expects capital spending by the five largest US hyperscalers and CoreWeave (CRWV.O) to reach nearly $1 trillion in 2027, financed through cash flows, debt and structures such as joint ventures and special-purpose vehicles However, a wave of loans coming due between 2027 and 2029 will test weaker borrowers’ ability to refinance at higher interest rates, Moody’s said About 17% of the 607 borrowers tracked by Moody’s used payment-in-kind interest, which allows companies to defer cash interest payments but adds to their debt burden A Reuters analysis earlier this year found loan maturities at US business development companies would [USN:L4N41A17M TEXT:"peak"] in 2028 and 2029 Recent stress in CoreWeave debt has also [USN:L4N46112V TEXT:"highlighted"] investors’ growing concerns about highly leveraged AI borrowers Moody's also flagged "circular" financing risks as technology companies, chipmakers and AI developers increasingly invest in, lend to and buy from one another, raising fears that correlated exposures could weaken together during a downturn
